hooks.name: claims-guard
hooks.description: On every agent save under apps/web/src/** or packages/core/src/story/**, runs the §5.4 vocabulary control (honesty.md, VOY-N-04): refuses forbidden phrasing ('travelled through', 'took the cable', 'your packet crossed', 'located in {city}' without a level, a bare '{n} km' travelled distance, 'countries your data crossed') in labels and story templates. Same logic as scripts/guards/vocabulary.guard.mjs in CI (§14.3: every file hook is also a CI guard).
